race.comment: STARZINTHEIREYES (3) progressive stayer who was backed off the map on resumption, when racing wide throughout and winding up strongly to just miss when second over 1600m at Randwick to The Mona Lisa. Will get cover today in a fast run contest and should be able to pick these up with ease. MISTER RIZZ (8) another import from the O'Shea & Charlton yard heading in the right direction. Justified the ($1.24) first-up with a dominant all-the-way win defeating inferior opposition over 1800m at Hawkesbury. Placed in BM78 class last May and will give a ton of cheek up on the speed. Don't treat lightly. MUKHTALIF (9) comes here with his hoof on the till third up after covering a stack of ground in the run with a game second over 1800m at this track. No problem at the trip and keep safe. PINHOLE (6) slashing run first up when saving ground along the inside to run third over 1600m at Randwick behind The Mona Lisa. Keep safe. ANTHRACITE (10) finds a stronger race today and place best.
